title: Bigin workflow with scheduled actions runs only once per record
symptoms: A deal that re-enters the trigger stage does not get the email series again
cause: Scheduled actions require Repeat this workflow to be off, so the workflow fires once per record.
fix: Plan for one run per record. If a record must get the series again, use a separate workflow or trigger it from an integration.
apply: Workflow: leave Repeat this workflow unchecked whenever the workflow has scheduled actions
